intent: Repair the uploaded diagnostic failures and all currently open issues on the single new draft branch. Resolve proven defects; add bounded privacy-preserving reporting for incidents lacking enough evidence; publish exact validation evidence and close each issue with an accurate resolution.

issue_snapshot.policy: Refresh before publication; do not equate diagnostic instrumentation with proof of a remote incident fix.

owners.provider_identity_arguments: audit_branch_code: original call replay, checkpoint durability, repeated argument failures and saved-view routing
owners.github_read_workflows: audit_runs: baseline grammar, status budgets and evidence, read-only CI guidance, PR labels and stale fixtures
owners.reporting_runtime: audit_runtime: incident capsules, schema/privacy/dedup, readiness targets, typed command404, JVM report fixture
owners.integration_and_delivery: root: typed integration routing, conversation transitions, compact preflight, diagnostics contention and bounded caches, canonical validation, publication and issue resolution

focused_behavior.boundary_limit: Host harnesses use disclosed Android/infrastructure boundary stubs; not full Android qualification.

authorization: User explicitly requested implementation, a single latest draft branch (or creation if absent), and issue closure after fix or additional diagnostic reporting.
